conversion.format: NSKeyedArchiver inside ZIP; active Brush.archive and optional Sub01 only
conversion.maskResize: Pillow LANCZOS, aspect ratio and full source extents retained; no enlargement
conversion.maskEncoding: base64 of run-length/alpha byte pairs; run length 1..255
conversion.grainInversion: Embedded grain grayscale is preserved; renderer applies textureInverted once
conversion.sourceParameters: all scalar parameters and pressure curves retained without rounding in JS; complete decoded active parameters below
conversion.omitted: Original files, Reset, author portraits, signatures, QuickLook previews and native binary color payloads
conversion.sourceOrder: brushset.plist order for a set; command-line input order for individual files
limitations: No bundled Procreate grain or shape bitmap is reconstructed from its filename.
Source enum values, size/count normalization and rendering equations are not claimed to be verified.
Web pixel sizes and fallback textures are adaptation choices; original values remain available.
Any maskInferredInversion is an explicit inferred correction, not a source flag; see component provenance.
